title: Reconcile the published V4 base archive and audit residual C1 claims
goal: Prevent stale local C1 archives from being mistaken for published 1.1.2 and identify the remaining architecture-gate implementation work.
acceptanceCriteria: The published 1.1.2 ZIP, sidecar, distribution manifest, receipt, installed inventory and Package hash agree exactly; a later-source ZIP is rejected.
The residual C1 matrix distinguishes implemented candidates, missing direct claims, absent subjects and compiled or evaluated evidence deferred to C5.
Formal Pre precedes verifier and inventory edits, the isolated IFX package regression passes, and no production Profile or bundle is accepted.
